refined_question: Let Γ₁ and Γ₂ be two Coxeter diagrams (finite labeled graphs encoding the integer orders m_{ij}≥2 for generators s_i and s_j). For each i, let W(Γ_i) be the Coxeter group defined by the presentation ⟨S_i | (s s')^{m_{s,s'}}=1 for all s,s'∈S_i⟩, where S_i is the vertex set of Γ_i and m_{s,s'} is the label on the edge between s and s' (with m_{s,s'}=2 when no edge exists). Decide whether the two abstract groups W(Γ₁) and W(Γ₂) are isomorphic.
equivalent_formulation: For a given Coxeter group W, determine all subsets S⊆W such that (W,S) forms a Coxeter system (i.e., S generates W and the pair satisfies the Coxeter relations) so as to enumerate all Coxeter presentations of W.
justification: The original name indicates the domain (Coxeter groups) and the type of problem (isomorphism decision), but does not specify how the groups are presented (via diagrams or generating sets), the precise relations, nor the decision nature. The refined question incorporates definitions of Coxeter diagrams, generators, relations, and the requirement to decide isomorphism. The alternate formulation follows directly from the source’s statement of an equivalent phrasing.
